title: Chapter 287 The Oath Is Established
content:
Chapter 287 The Oath Is Established

Yes, if Xiao Yin is there.

Not to mention the peak of the Immortal Saint Realm in front of you, even if his original body comes, it is just a matter of suppression.

It’s a pity that the reality is that Xiao Yin is not there.

"In fact, I have heard some rumors about the ancient battlefield."

At this time, the phantom suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Xue and the others frowned slightly.

"You want to enter the ancient battlefield, too?"

Lu Xue asked.

The phantom did not hide it and nodded directly.

"How about making a deal?"

"What deal?"

"Take me into the ancient battlefield with you. At that time, I can take action to protect you once."

"You fucking beautifully!"

As soon as the phantom finished speaking, Xiao Luo couldn't help but curse.

What kind of transaction is this? Isn’t this a robber?

Lu Xue and Qin Feng did not speak, but they also looked at the phantom with a bad expression.

Do you really think they are easy to bully?

"I tell you that if you want to enter the ancient battlefield, unless I, Xiao clan, nodded, even if you are the top of the monster list, you won't want to enter!"

Xiao Luo pointed to the phantom in the distance and spoke domineeringly.

The reason why Xiao Luo dared to do this was the confidence that the Xiao clan brought him.

This is the benefit of being a big force.

Hearing Xiao Luo's words, the phantom obviously became silent.

At this time, Lu Xue also said, "If you have no sincerity, it is probably impossible to enter the ancient battlefield."

"And if you trespass on me, Zhuyun Peak, this matter will not be a good idea."

"I, the Lord of Zhuyun Peak, is just not here for the time being, but I am not dead."

A few words were all threatening the phantom in front of you.

Lu Xue and his men instantly occupied the home court.

I really think they are so easy to enter Zhuyun Peak.

So what if you run away now.

When the instructor Xiao Yin comes back, with the strength of the instructor Xiao Yin, it will be easy to find you out.

Unless you never go back to the academy.

After a long time, the phantom finally spoke.

"Haha, I really underestimate you."

The next moment, the space trembled.

The phantom gradually condensed.

A handsome face appeared in front of several people.

The man said lightly, "I will introduce myself. My name is Chu Lingsheng, a native of Tiandi Academy."

Chu Lingsheng!

"You are Chu Lingsheng!"

Qin Feng immediately said in surprise.

Xiao Luo was stunned on the side and quickly reacted.

The 22nd place in the evil list.

In fact, there is danger.

They just heard of Chu Lingsheng in the academy, but no one has seen him.

It can be said that the dragon has no end to see its head.

"You are a monster on the list of monsters, but you actually do such stealing things."

It's really shameful to eavesdrop on them.

Upon hearing this, Chu Lingsheng smiled faintly and said, "I have never said that I am a gentleman."

Apparently, he admitted it.

And he doesn't care about his reputation at all.

Qin Feng and the others were silent.

Unexpectedly, Chu Lingsheng was such a person.

At this time, Chu Lingsheng looked at Lu Xue, "Miss Lu, your name is very loud in the academy recently."

"But they all underestimated you, including me. If I hadn't seen you personally, I would have thought you were just tenth in the martial arts list."

That's it.

In his eyes, the tenth place in the martial arts list is just that.

"What do you want to say?"

Lu Xue said coldly.

Upon hearing this, Chu Lingsheng said directly: "The same thing is true. I want to cooperate with you and enter the ancient battlefield together."

"You're thinking about nothing."

Lu Xue responded ruthlessly.

You just go in, who do you think you are.

Chu Lingsheng couldn't help frowning slightly, "What do you want?"

"I don't lack anything."

Lu Xue waved her hand.

In response to this, Chu Lingsheng only thought Lu Xue was stubborn and then continued, "The ancient battlefield is full of crises. Are you afraid of having a life to take it? Take me with you. Then I can protect you once."

Hearing this, Lu Xue said disdainfully: "You also know that the ancient battlefield is full of crises. If you have some strength, do you don't know what your surname is? Don't protect us yet, and you'll be burping first."

"And we have entered the ancient battlefield. Where can we find you? We really treat us as fools, right?"

Qin Feng and Xiao Luo on the side gave a thumbs up.

Sister Xue is good at confronting her.

I just can't stand this guy so arrogant.

Chu Lingsheng also heard what Lu Xue meant, because he thought he gave him less.

"What do you think of?"

Lu Xue was a little stunned. Did this guy surrender so easily?

"After entering the ancient battlefield, no matter what you gain, you will have to share half of us."

"Oh by the way, I still have to protect us when it's time to protect us."

"What!"

Chu Lingsheng couldn't believe his ears.

Is the lion talking so much?

It's half way up.

"Half is too much, can Sanqi Branch be?"

"No, just half."

"Four and six points."

"No, just half."

Finally, Chu Lingsheng had no choice but to nod and agreed.

Usually half.

And Lu Xue is talking about the harvest. At that time, he will use it to improve his strength. Isn’t it enough to give the rest to Lu Xue and the others.

Chu Lingsheng thought so in his heart.

At this time, Lu Xue threw Chu Lingsheng an exquisite ring.

"Give it, if you have gained something, just stuff half of it in it. Swear."

Looking at the ring in his hand, Chu Lingsheng was silent.

Lu Xue looks so stupid, why is she so smart?

Chu Lingsheng sighed and then sweared.

But at this time, Lu Xue suddenly stopped Chu Lingsheng and then said something to Chu Lingsheng.

"Ah? What kind of oath is this?"

"Oh, just say as you say."

Chu Lingsheng was helpless, everything was for the ancient battlefield.

Then Chu Lingsheng raised his hand and shouted to the void: "I, Chu Lingsheng, swore to Lu Daosheng, the lord of the Huangcheng City, and he would definitely abide by the agreement, otherwise he would be destroyed and he would never be reborn."

After talking.

Chu Lingsheng looked up at the void, feeling a little happy.

The Lord of the Huangcheng City has never heard of it. What's the use of this vow?

At the same time, in a quiet starry sky.

"Huh? What's the situation?"

Lu Daosheng opened his eyes and looked behind him.

After a long time, Lu Daosheng understood.

He actually took the oath to come to him. I'm sorry, if you breach the contract, it would be even more serious than God's punishment.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng's index finger moved slightly.

A terrifying force of order suddenly shot away and disappeared into the starry sky.

Inside the peak of the cloud.

At this time, Chu Lingsheng was relaxed. He thought Lu Xue was quite smart, but it turned out that he was thinking too much.

At that time, whether you follow your oath depends on his mood.

At this time, he did not notice the sarcastic gazes of Qin Feng and Xiao Luo at all.

Swear to the Lord of the Wilderness City.

That is much more terrifying than swearing to the sky.

Please be blessed with yourself.

And Chu Lingsheng's idea had just emerged.

Suddenly, a terrifying force of order suddenly enveloped him and disappeared the next moment.

But Chu Lingsheng's face changed drastically.

A drop of cold sweat slid down Chu Lingsheng's cheek.

The pledge was established!

At the same time, there is somewhere in the Tiandi Academy.

A man looked around in horror. At that moment, a threat of death hit him.

What a horrible oath.

It actually pointed directly at his body!
